rule_clauses.text: The occurrence, attribution, and timing of a qualifying military action will be primarily determined based on a consensus of information available from the resolution sources.
A qualifying military action refers to an air strike or a surface-to-surface missile strike, initiated by the United States, that directly impacts Iran.
The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments and militaries of the United States and Iran and credible reporting.

Where territorial borders are disputed, all territory claimed by and under the de facto control of Iran as of market creation will qualify.
Debris, fragments, or any wreckage from intercepted munitions that land on Iran do not constitute a military action regardless of any damage incurred.
No single statement, denial, or presentation of evidence will govern where it is contradicted by the totality of information.
